import os, sys; os.chdir(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "..")); sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import pe_deal_graph.queries  # noqa: F401
from pe_deal_graph.model.core import model, Company, EligibleTarget, Ownership, Fund
from relationalai.semantics.std import aggregates as aggs

o = Ownership.ref()
df = model.where(EligibleTarget(Company), Company.score >= 70).select(
    Company.name.alias("name"),
    Company.score.alias("score"),
    (aggs.count(o).per(Company).where(o.company(Company), o.is_current()) | 0).alias("current_owners"),
).to_df()
print(df.sort_values("score", ascending=False).to_string(index=False))

f = Fund.ref()
df2 = model.where(EligibleTarget(Company), Company.score >= 70, o.company(Company), o.is_current(), o.fund(f)).select(
    Company.name.alias("name"),
    f.name.alias("fund"),
    o.stake_type.alias("stake"),
    o.start_date.alias("since"),
).to_df()
print(df2.to_string(index=False))
